name: Fargo
description: A close-knit anthology series dealing with stories involving malice, violence and murder based in and around Minnesota.

videos.title: Greetings from Bemidji
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes to uncover the art of casting Bemidji's many colorful residents.

videos.title: Shades of Green
videos.overview: This slightly weird and weirdly engaging featurette focuses on Lorne Malvo, creating a hitman steeped in ambiguity and mystery, Thorton's performance, his hair, make-up and costuming, and his presence, spoken and unspoken. Also covered, Adam Goldberg and Russell Harvard's killers, their snowy encounter with Malvo, and the use of the wolf near the end of the season.

videos.title: This Is a True Story
videos.overview: Two-part documentary wherein the cast and crew discuss the freedom of television, the surprisingly long history of the project, adapting the Coen Brothers' film (with their blessing), the elements of the script and series that drew them to the show, striking the proper tone, honoring the past while pressing on toward the future, creating new characters to inhabit an already established story, shooting in Calgary, and much more.

videos.title: Lou on Lou: A Conversation with Patrick Wilson, Keith Carradine and Noah Hawley
videos.overview: An exploration of the character played by Wilson and Carradine at different stages of life.

videos.title: The Films of Ronald Reagan with Audio Commentary by Bruce Campbell
The History of True Crime in the Mid West
videos.overview: An exploration of the idea that the stories of each season come from a book.

videos.title: Waffles and Bullet Holes: A Return to Sioux Falls
videos.overview: A set of two featurettes which offer some good interviews.

videos.title: The Crocodile's Dilemma
videos.overview: A meek, mild insurance salesman meets a rootless, manipulative stranger in the hospital, which initiates terrible and gruesome events that will change the salesman's life forever.

videos.title: The Rooster Prince
videos.overview: Molly begins to suspect that Lester is involved with the murders, but her new boss points her in a different direction. Meanwhile, Malvo investigates the blackmail plot against a man known as the Supermarket King.

videos.title: A Muddy Road
videos.overview: Malvo flips the script on the blackmail operation, Molly sets a trap, and Gus debates whether he should come clean. Lester's return to work has complicated repercussions.

videos.title: Eating the Blame
videos.overview: When Gus tries to right a wrong, Malvo embraces his alter ego. Lester finds himself in a surprising situation, and Molly uncovers a promising lead.

videos.title: The Six Ungraspables
videos.overview: When Lester has a close call, Molly makes an unorthodox decision. Gus weighs some neighborly advice, and Malvo gets what he wants.

videos.title: Buridan's Ass
videos.overview: Malvo executes his master plan, while Lester attempts to craft one of his own. Gus and Molly team up in Duluth.

videos.title: Who Shaves the Barber?
videos.overview: Malvo seeks answers, while Lester finagles a few of his own. Molly and Gus try to get past a setback in the investigation.

videos.title: The Heap
videos.overview: Molly faces pressure to close the case, while Lester starts to feel like a new man.

videos.title: A Fox, a Rabbit, and a Cabbage
videos.overview: Lester has an unexpected encounter, Malvo changes course, and a new investigation leads Molly down a familiar path.

videos.title: Morton's Fork
videos.overview: Molly takes the lead, while Gus pursues a hunch. Lester manipulates a situation, and Malvo finds a new target.

videos.title: Waiting for Dutch
videos.overview: In 1979, an unexpected turn of events at a diner disrupts the lives of the citizens in a small Minnesota town.

videos.title: Before the Law
videos.overview: The Gerhardts get a surprising offer, and two unlikely murderers do their best to clean up their mess.

videos.title: The Myth of Sisyphus
videos.overview: The Gerhardts' search for Rye intensifies. Lou takes a trip to Fargo. Peggy overhears a new theory about the Waffle Hut shooter.

videos.title: Fear and Trembling
videos.overview: Floyd responds to Kansas City’s proposal, Hanzee takes a road trip, and Lou has a realization.

videos.title: The Gift of the Magi
videos.overview: Floyd takes action, and Charlie tries to prove himself. Peggy and Ed disagree about what to do next, while Lou finds himself sidelined during Ronald Reagan’s campaign tour.

videos.title: Rhinoceros
videos.overview: Lou and Hank try to prevent an altercation, Peggy and Ed defend their choices and the Gerhardt clan attempts to get back one of their own.

videos.title: Did You Do This? No, You Did It!
videos.overview: Lou and Hank investigate in Fargo, The King of Breakfast visits Betsy and Molly, Floyd is summoned away and Bear questions a family member’s loyalty.

videos.title: Loplop
videos.overview: Hanzee searches for Peggy and Ed. Dodd ends up in unfamiliar territory.

videos.title: The Castle
videos.overview: Peggy and Ed agree to follow through with their plan at the Motor Motel, Lou faces jurisdictional politics and Hanzee reports back to the Gerhardts.

videos.title: Palindrome
videos.overview: Peggy and Ed make a run for it.

videos.title: The Law of Vacant Places
videos.overview: A twisted sibling rivalry leads to murder, mobsters and cutthroat competitive bridge in a small Midwestern town.

videos.title: The Principle of Restricted Choice
videos.overview: Gloria deals with the aftermath of a crime, Varga makes a move, and Ray and Nikki move on to Plan B.

videos.title: The Law of Non-Contradiction
videos.overview: Gloria revisits her stepfather's past to try and find some answers.

videos.title: The Narrow Escape Problem
videos.overview: Emmit and Sy try to figure out what they've gotten themselves into, Nikki and Ray track down some collateral, and Gloria learns more about Maurice.

videos.overview: Nikki and Ray's retaliation has consequences for Emmit. Meanwhile, Gloria and Winnie start connecting the dots.

videos.title: Somebody to Love
videos.overview: Gloria follows the money, Nikki plays a game and Emmit learns a lesson about progress from Varga. Season finale.

videos.title: East/West

videos.overview: Munch makes a bold move, Indira and Witt have questions, Wayne takes a fall and Gator disappoints.

videos.overview: Dot creates diversions, Roy meets his match and Indira helps a new friend.
